jobs.description:
Job description
Are you a visionary software architect looking for a challenge that goes beyond standard app development? At Teledyne FLIR in Täby, we build the sensor systems and thermal cameras used globally in fire detection, industrial applications, and blue-light equipment. Now, we need your expertise to shape the brain inside these life-saving products.

We are on a journey to centralize and streamline our Linux-based product offerings into one robust, unified software platform. As our new Embedded Software Architect, you will own the long-term vision, architecture, and roadmap for our Android/AOSP-based platform.
This is a high-impact, strategic, and hands-on role. You will be the technical anchor for our R&D, tasked with balancing urgent product needs with sustainable, scalable, and reusable strategies. You won’t just maintain an architecture; you will define it.

What we offer you
True Autonomy: The mandate to define architectural principles and shape the future of our R&D.
A Collaborative Culture: You will work within a highly skilled, senior team of architects in an environment that values mentorship, continuous learning, and innovation.
Global Impact: The code you architect will run in critical systems used worldwide, making a tangible difference in commercial and government sectors.

Application:
Are you ready to take command of our platform architecture and drive innovation? We look forward to your application. Please note that this role is security-classified, and a security vetting process will be conducted as part of the recruitment. 

Responsibilities
Drive Platform Strategy: Own the long-term architectural vision for our software platform, balancing urgent product needs with sustainable, reusable strategies.
Lead Integration: Facilitate cross-functional synchronization across multiple teams to ensure scale, performance, and security.
Translate Requirements: Collaborate with product management to convert system and business needs into high-level platform technical requirements.
Technical Leadership: Act as the primary spokesperson for the platform area, guiding engineering decisions and fostering a culture of technical excellence.
Drive Modernization: Lead the effort to centralize and streamline our Linux-based product offerings into a robust, unified platform.

Qualifications
We believe you thrive at the intersection of complex software, system engineering, and product development. You are a strategic problem-solver with a proven track record of leading technical decisions and successfully managing multiple product launches.
To succeed in this role, we see that you have:
Deep, hands-on expertise in Android platform architecture, AOSP, and embedded Linux.
A strong background in embedded software development and system integration.
The capacity to influence stakeholders and teams through clear, technical communication.
Fluency in English (professional proficiency in Swedish is a merit).
A relevant academic degree (e.g., M.Sc. in Computer Science/Engineering) OR equivalent deep, practical experience in the field.

About the company

Randstad
På Randstad vet vi att alla människor har en plats på arbetsmarknaden. Med verksamhet över hela landet och inom alla kompetensområden hjälper vi människor att hitta ett jobb som känns bra, och där de får möjlighet att växa, utvecklas och uppnå sin fulla potential. 
Med närmare 600 000 anställda i 38 länder är Randstad världsledande inom HR-tjänster, med målsättningen att bli världens främsta och mest uppskattade partner på arbetsmarknaden. Genom att kombinera vår passion för människor med kraften i dagens teknologi hjälper vi människor och företag att uppnå deras fulla potential. Vi kallar det Human Forward.

About the Role
As a Senior Backend Engineer in the Orders team, you will shape the overall architecture, technical direction, and scalability of our core order-handling engine. The Orders domain is central to Instabee’s operations, processing deliveries for millions of consumers across Europe.
In this role, you’ll take on a high-leverage technical leadership position—driving architectural decisions, integrating modern technologies, and elevating engineering standards across our distributed systems.
Key Responsibilities
Architect Core Systems: Lead the technical design, scalability, and resilience of our high-throughput order backbone.

Integrate AI & Modern Tech: Proactively adopt AI tools, LLMs, and smart automations to boost system capabilities and developer workflows.

Drive Strategy & Mentorship: Partner with product leaders to align tech roadmaps with business goals while coaching junior and mid-level engineers.

Continuous Optimization: Audit, refactor, and evolve our distributed microservices to ensure top-tier reliability and performance.

Collaborative Engineering: Champion technical excellence through high-standard code reviews, mob/pair programming, and shared ownership.

Your Future Team
The Orders team builds and maintains the core engine responsible for the end-to-end order lifecycle—from creation to successful delivery. Supported by an Engineering Manager, Product Manager, and Staff Engineer, you will operate with high autonomy in a tight-knit, collaborative environment where your technical decisions carry direct, company-wide impact.
What We’re Looking For
Senior Backend Background: Solid track record of architecting and operating resilient, high-throughput distributed systems in production.

Core Stack: Deep, hands-on expertise in Node.js and TypeScript.

Databases: Advanced experience with MongoDB (or similar NoSQL/relational systems), including query optimization and schema design at scale.

Cloud & Infrastructure: Strong proficiency with Kubernetes and hands-on experience with GCP (or equivalent cloud environments).

AI-Forward Mindset: Practical curiosity for applying AI tooling and developer automations to streamline engineering and operational workflows.

Technical Leadership: Ability to take complex initiatives from concept to production while communicating architectural trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical peers.

Fluency in English: Confident verbal and written communication.

(We value curiosity, problem-solving, and adaptability over ticking every single stack requirement on day one.)
What We Offer
Significant architectural ownership within one of the Nordics' most high-volume logistics platforms.

A culture of technical ambition, continuous learning, and minimal bureaucracy.

A supportive, senior engineering peer group focused on code quality and innovation.

Perks & Benefits:

🏢 Brand-New Office: Modern collaborative workspace in our new Stockholm HQ.

🐶 Dog-Friendly Office: Designated dog-friendly areas throughout the office.

🏓 Fun & Games: Foosball, shuffleboard, table tennis, and an in-house karaoke room.

👶 Parental Top-Up: 6 months of parental pay support.

🎂 Birthday Off: An extra paid day off each year to celebrate your birthday.

⏰ Flexible Hybrid Setup: Flexible working hours tailored to balance life and work.

About Instabee
Formed in 2022 through the merger of Budbee and Instabox (uniting the Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy brands), Instabee provides seamless e-commerce deliveries to millions of consumers. We are growing quickly across the Nordics and continental Europe, building cutting-edge logistics technology that handles millions of parcels each week.
As part of our standard recruitment process in Sweden, mandatory confidential background checks are conducted via Svensk Bakgrundsanalys.

Senior Wiring & Harness Engineer
Location: Gothenburg, Sweden
Company: Integro Consulting
Assignment: Client project within Automotive development
About the Role
Integro Consulting is looking for a Senior Wiring & Harness Engineer to join our client's team in Gothenburg. In this role, you will contribute to the development of electrical wiring harnesses and installation solutions for buses, ensuring that designs meet technical requirements, packaging constraints and project specifications.
You will work closely with project teams and other engineers within Platform Development to develop new solutions, improve existing designs and ensure high-quality technical documentation. The role also involves taking the lead in component installation and media routing activities, contributing your technical expertise and supporting project teams in solving complex engineering challenges.
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop electrical wiring harnesses and installation solutions for buses.
Lead and support component installation and media routing activities.
Develop and document new design solutions using KAP and CATIA V5.
Investigate and evaluate existing and new technical solutions documented in KOLA and CATIA.
Perform electrical wiring design using Saber, including 2D wiring design.
Develop and manage routing and packaging solutions for electrical wiring harnesses and power cables.
Work with other media routing requirements, including pneumatic pipes and brake hoses.
Support PIL activities and implement design adjustments throughout the project lifecycle.
Collaborate closely with project teams and Platform Development to ensure that solutions meet technical requirements and project objectives.
Take ownership of technical challenges and lead activities when required.

Qualifications and Experience
We are looking for a technically strong and detail-oriented engineer with the ability to take responsibility and drive engineering activities forward.
Required qualifications:
A master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics or a related field, and/or several years of relevant professional experience.
Strong knowledge of Saber for 2D wiring design.
Good knowledge of CATIA V5, particularly electrical wiring harness and power cable routing and packaging.
Experience with media routing solutions, such as electrical harnesses, pneumatic pipes or brake hoses.
Strong analytical skills and a structured, detail-oriented approach to engineering.
A high level of commitment, accuracy and ownership.
Leadership skills and the ability to take the lead in technical activities and projects.
Professional fluency in English.

Preferred qualifications:
Experience working with Volvo Group systems and development processes.
Familiarity with KOLA and related engineering documentation.
Experience developing and maintaining electrical installation solutions in complex vehicle development projects.

Who You Are
You are an experienced engineer who combines strong technical expertise with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset. You enjoy working with complex engineering challenges, investigating technical solutions and ensuring that every detail meets the required standards.
You are comfortable taking the lead when needed, collaborating across engineering teams and driving activities forward in a structured and professional manner.
If you have a strong background in electrical wiring design and enjoy taking ownership of technical solutions, we would like to hear from you.
Apply Now
Are you ready for your next engineering challenge?
Submit your CV and tell us how your experience in wiring harness design, Saber and CATIA V5 could contribute to this assignment.

jobs.occupation: Internship in Refrigeration Circuit Engineering Department
jobs.description:
Company Description
Bosch Thermotechnology AB in Tranås develops, manufactures, and sells advanced heat pumps that harness energy from nature’s own resources – rock, water, and air.
In Tranås, you’ll find both our production unit and our competence and development center, where we constantly strive to stay at the forefront. Here we create smart solutions that simplify everyday life, contribute to a greener future, and provide our customers with safety and comfort

We believe in technology that makes a difference – technology that is Invented for life.

Job Description
Your contribution to something big
As part of this internship, you will engage in a diverse range of tasks, including:
Improving products by testing prototypes and/or serial appliances
Taking responsibility and contributing by coordinating project related topics
Supporting the team and development projects with analytical studies or simulations
Spreading and conserving knowledge by presenting and documenting test results or project findings
Involving yourself in research by studying and assessing new development ideas
Being creative and preparing or participating in development project related workshops

Duration of the internship: 6 months, preferably starting in March 2027
Location: on-site in our plant in Tranås, Sweden

Qualifications
What distinguishes you
Currently studying Mechanical Engineering or equivalent in the Bachelor's or Master's
Good written and verbal communication skills in English
Willingness to take on responsibility and drive work within your own initiative
Effective communication, teamwork abilities and comfortable working in an international team environment
Eagerness to learn and grow outside your field of studies
Strong logical reasoning and attention to detail
Critical thinking to analyze complex problems and dependencies
Knowledge in thermodynamics, fluid mechanics and refrigeration
Able to write engineering grade technical documentation
Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Project)
Basic knowledge of Matlab/Simulink is an advantage

Additional Information
What we offer you
We offer monetary compensation to support you during your internship.
Free accommodation in Tranås is provided
To support your well-being, we provide a wellness contribution for use on fitness, sports, or wellness services
We cover your travel costs from your residence to Tranås, making relocation easier for you
You gain valuable experience working within an international company with global connections

Welcome to Tranås – the heart of Bosch Home Comfort in Sweden
Tranås, beautifully located by the idyllic Lake Sommen and surrounded by forests and nature reserves, is home to Bosch Thermotechnology AB in Sweden. Here, more than 600 associates work in manufacturing and research & development of innovative heating solutions for a sustainable future.
At Bosch, we care about you, our business, and the environment.
We offer more than a job – we help you grow in your career and as a person. Life is about balance, and we support your goals, whether they involve new challenges, development, or time for family and hobbies.
Join a workplace that values individuality, openness, and trust, where you can be yourself and be inspired by diverse perspectives from around the globe.
Join us in Tranås and be part of shaping tomorrow’s energy solutions – in a workplace where innovation meets quality of life.
Here, you’ll find not just a job – but a lifestyle. #LikeABosch

jobs.description:
The opportunity
Hitachi Energy Transformers- Business Solutions IT Organization is seeking a Factory IT Site Delivery Manager for Ludvika who will provide overall service delivery to the site to drive value and business growth to the business.
As Site IT Service Delivery Manager (SDM), you are responsible for building and providing specific IT Solutions/Services interfacing the business, consulting with the Site BU leads, business application owners and IT stakeholders on IT-related topics. 
This role is responsible for ensuring all IT infrastructure and applications are delivered to the site as well as management of Ticket Management and Escalations.
The Site IT SDM is the key point of escalation and is accountable for local business relationship management for IT service performance; you are responsible for aggregating demand for new and improved IT services required by the business and ensuring overall business satisfaction with IT services.
In this role, you lead site IT professionals, managing vendor relationships, and ensuring that service delivery processes and procedures are followed to meet the organization's objectives.
How you’ll make an impact
Manage and lead the Site IT team, ensuring proper staffing, skills, and organization.
Act as the main point of contact for IT suppliers and CDC teams on IT-related matters.
Ensure effective ticket management, including triage and escalation processes.
Provide onsite IT infrastructure support and delivery, including project management for IT builds.
Maintain governance, IT security, and cybersecurity operations, including first response to incidents.
Gather and manage business requirements and ensure access to necessary applications.
Oversee IT budget planning, cost control, and network connectivity, including machine integration.
Coordinate applications, vendors, and support the development and motivation of team members.

Your background
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Engineering or 10+ years in Information Systems.
At least 4 years of experience in an IT management role.
Strong communication skills in English and good proficiency in Swedish.
Proven experience (2+ years) managing complex global IT projects.
Background in process management, continuous improvement, and business process optimization.
Understanding of manufacturing operations, change management, and cross-functional collaboration.
Experience with complex stakeholder environments and strong knowledge of IT policies and end-to-end business processes.
Familiarity with key tools and methodologies (e.g., MS Office, ServiceNow, Azure, SAP S/4HANA, ITIL, Lean Six Sigma) and ability to manage IT resources in a multi-shift factory environment.

Curamet AB
Curamet AB is an IT services and solutions company based in Malmö, Sweden. We help businesses across technology, telecom, banking, healthcare and retail develop secure, reliable and cost-effective digital solutions.
Our expertise spans cloud services, DevOps and software delivery. By combining Agile ways of working with automation and modern engineering practices, we help our customers accelerate development, improve operational efficiency and bring new solutions to market faster.
As we grow, we’re looking for colleagues who enjoy solving technical challenges and sharing their expertise. Join our team to collaborate with experienced professionals and contribute to projects that improve how businesses build and run their technology.
Duties
You are an experienced UX Designer with a strong background in complex enterprise, retail, or space planning products. You are comfortable designing for varied user groups and contexts, from store-floor activities to specialist expansion planning, and you can balance immediate MVP needs with a coherent long-term experience. 
Please note that we will not consider applications without portfolios. Applications need to be in English.
 
The main tasks in the assignment are as below: 
As our UX Designer, you'll lead the design of a simple, guided, scalable planning experience for both day-to-day operations and major commercial projects such as new stores, expansions, and rebuilds.
Design intuitive, scalable planning experiences: Understand the different user journeys and experiences within the tool.
Lead user-centred discovery and design: Plan and conduct research, map end-to-end journeys, identify pain points and translate insights into clear design priorities.
Prototype, test and refine continuously: Create flows and prototypes, validate them with users in multiple markets, and use feedback and evidence to guide the development.
 Simplify complex planning workflows: Turn business rules, spatial constraints, product data, and 3D models into guided experiences that are easy to learn and efficient to use.
 Shape a connected, reusable design foundation: Collaborate with engineering and platform teams on integration with other commercial planning solutions, retail equipment and shared planning data, while using design systems and reusable patterns to support future scale.
You lean forward and embrace the possibilities of AI-assisted design and software development

Essential Skills and Knowledge:
Collect input about user needs, business needs, and tech capabilities from stakeholders.
Collaborate with Developers, Product Leaders, and other UX professionals.
Design intuitive experiences for interactive products.
Improve existing experiences or build new ones from scratch
Create flows, journeys, and interaction patterns for interactive products
Design prototypes of various fidelities for research, testing, communication, and cross-functional alignment.
Ensure end-user experiences are world-class and deliver on user outcomes agreed with Business Leaders and Product Leaders.

 
Following competences must be fulfilled: 
You’re a UX Designer with at least 5 years of experience designing complex digital products, confident in your craft and eager to grow through collaboration and shared learning.
You’re skilled in wireframing, prototyping, information architecture and design systems, with proficiency in tools such as Figma, Framer and Miro; experience with data-rich, spatial or 3D-enabled workflows is an advantage.

Öppen för alla
Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

What will you do?
As a Senior Android Engineer at Rebtel, you will be part of our Frontend team, helping modernize and evolve the Rebtel Android app. We are in the middle of migrating from Java to Kotlin and Jetpack Compose while continuously shipping product features to a global user base.
You’ll work in a small, empowered team where your technical decisions matter. This role is a mix of building new features, refactoring legacy code, collaborating cross-functionally, and shaping the future of our Android platform.
Areas of ownership:

Drive the migration from Java to a modern Kotlin + Compose stack

Refactor code that slows us down and proactively pay down tech debt

Build and modernize Android features using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose

Contribute to architecture decisions (MVVM/MVI, Coroutines, platform improvements)

jobs.description:
As a Swedish  (or Norwegian, Dutch, Danish)  Client Service Associate, you will be a part of an energetic environment managing daily tasks at one of the world's preeminent private money managers. The Day-to-Day:

Help Investment Counsellors with relationship management by working with existing clients on operational inquiries

Be a direct contact or expert in multiple subjects to develop your skills once you assume more responsibility

Your Qualifications:
A university degree or equivalent combination of education and experience (Finance/Economics/Business is a plus)

Native/Fluent Swedish and English skills

You can connect with a wide array of audiences by phone and email with a focus on client service

Work well in a collaborative, team-oriented setting

Commitment to maintain quality of work while sticking to a timeline

The organisation distinguishes itself by putting clients first, providing unmatched service, and taking a personalised approach to investing. You can feel confident knowing that we align with our clients’ best interests by using a simple and transparent fee structure and recognised European custodians.
It’s the people that make the purpose possible, and to help our employees meet their long-term goals, we offer an array of benefits, including:
100% paid premiums for our top-tier supplemental medical, dental and annual health screening plans for employees and their qualified dependents
28 days annual leave, with the ability to purchase up to 3 additional days per year, plus up to 8 paid holidays
Enhanced maternity pay package with 16 weeks’ top up to full base pay for eligible employees
$10,000* fertility, hormonal health and family-forming benefit
A retirement pension plan, featuring a 9% company contribution of base pay with an additional company match of up to 5% of base pay on personal contributions
Gym subsidy of up to £50 per month
Employee Assistance Program and other emotional wellbeing services
A collaborative working environment that practises ongoing training, educational support and employee appreciation events
This is an in-office role. Based on your role, tenure, and performance eligibility you may have the opportunity to participate in our hybrid work from home program. This program is subject to change.

Core mission:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year, we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.
The ILL's Services for Advanced Neutron Environments (SANE) is responsible for the development, maintenance and user support of neutron instruments. In order to maintain our leadership position and ensure a high standard of service, we wish to modernise and improve the sample environment controllers used on the neutron beams.

Your tasks:
You will join the team of the Services for Advanced Neutron Environments and will contribute to the development and commissioning of new controllers:
- PLC and HMI programming and commissioning of:
* power supply panels for 1100°C and 1600°C furnaces
* 2000-bar helium pressure generators
* cryostat test benches
- Investigation of the application of machine learning to control systems and predictive maintenance.

Your profile:
- You hold a Level 7 qualification (Master's degree or equivalent) in Automation Engineering, with several years' experience using human-machine interface (EXOR) and PLC (Schneider) development tools.
- You are passionate about systems automation, are keen to work in a multicultural environment, and enjoy tackling technical challenges.
- You are a strong team player and have good analytical skills.
- You are keen to be involved in every stage of a project, from the design phase through to commissioning.

What we offer:
Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a secure 'specified-purpose' fixed-term position based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more information, please visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

Sounds interesting?
Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online - preferably in English - via our career portal, quoting reference number 26/49.
Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness, including for work under ionising radiation, is required. We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research
facility for fundamental research using neutrons. United by our passion for progress and
technology, we drive science and research forward every day. Together, we can pave the way
for discoveries that will help to make our world a better place.

About Bodycote
At Bodycote, we’re more than the world’s leading provider of heat treatment and specialist thermal processing services. We’re a people business at heart. Our commitment to innovation and sustainability shapes everything we do. With a global footprint and a culture built on collaboration, curiosity, and continuous improvement, we create an environment where you can grow, contribute, and make a meaningful impact. Sustainability is central to our future. We’re on an ambitious journey to reduce our environmental impact through advanced technologies, smarter processes, and ongoing innovation, with our teams around the world playing a key role in making that happen.
The Role
As a Material Testing Lab Technician, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of materials through testing, analysis, and reporting. You will prepare and test material samples, operate and maintain laboratory equipment, and use digital tools to record and evaluate test results.
You will work closely with the Laboratory Manager and cross-functional stakeholders to support quality assurance, product development, and continuous improvement activities. In addition to conducting standardized tests, you will help maintain laboratory equipment, contribute to the accuracy and integrity of laboratory data, and ensure that all work is carried out in accordance with established safety and quality standards.
This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys practical laboratory work, has a keen eye for detail, and takes pride in producing accurate and reliable results.
Responsibilities
• Sample Preparation: Collect, handle, and prepare physical samples for testing.
• Conducting Tests: Perform standardized physical, mechanical, and minor chemical tests (e.g., strength, hardness, density, and corrosion properties) using digital tools and laboratory machinery.
• Equipment Maintenance: Clean, maintain, and calibrate testing devices regularly to ensure accuracy.
• Data Analysis & Reporting: Record test results, analyze data for compliance or failure causes, and draft technical reports.
• Safety Compliance: Follow strict laboratory safety protocols and wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE).
Who We’re Looking For
We’re looking for someone who brings:

A technical high school diploma or similar

Experience in materials testing and laboratory testing within the metals or manufacturing industry.

Familiarity of relevant standards and quality requirements, including ISO 9001 and ISO 17025.

Excellent ability to document, analyse and report technical results.

Good command of both Swedish and English, verbally and in writing.

Basic math and computer proficiency

What’s In It for You

Career progression opportunities within a global business

Exposure to operational development and continuous improvement initiatives 

A supportive, inclusive culture where your growth and development matter 

The opportunity to play a key role in daily operations and team performance 

Competitive salary and benefits package 

Location & Work Pattern
This role is a full time, permanent position based in Västerås, with onsite expectations. Some travel may be required depending on business needs.
Ready to Apply?
If you’re ready to join Bodycote and make a real impact, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and start your journey with us.
We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered regardless of characteristics protected by local law, including (where applicable) gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, religion or belief, and ethnic origin. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment.

Company Description
Welcome to a world, where your ideas lead to something big. Welcome to Bosch!
Bosch Thermoteknik AB in Tranås develops, manufactures, and sells heat pumps for the European market. We are approximately 650 employees and form part of the large Bosch Group, which consists of approximately 417,000 employees worldwide.
We work with sustainable simplification of everyday life where the focus is on the environment, innovation, and development. In Tranås there is a production unit and a competence and development center. The heat pumps we manufacture draw energy from different sources - the mountain, the water, or the air. We work to constantly be at the forefront and contribute to sustainable energy and a better environment with the goal of creating a simplified everyday life for our customers. In short, we create technology that is "Invented for life".
Job Description

As an Intern in Human Resources at Bosch Thermoteknik AB, you will support our HR Business Partners with general administrative HR tasks.
You will be involved in the recruitment process, including the preparation of agreements and onboarding of new associates
Organizing and tracking of various associate trainings will also be part of your area of responsibility

In addition to these tasks, you will also be responsible for your own project, process or reporting task

Location: on-site in our plant in Tranås, Sweden
Qualifications

Currently studying Business Administration, Social Sciences, Psychology or similar, ideally with a focus on HR
Basic knowledge in Microsoft Office tools (esp. Excel and PowerPoint)
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Ability to take responsibility for own work and apply own initiative to find solutions
Results-oriented and pro-active attitude

Additional Information

We can offer free accommodation in Tranås
To support your well-being, we provide a wellness contribution for use on fitness, sports, or wellness services

You gain valuable experience working within an international company with global connections

 
At Bosch, we care for you, our business, and our environment. Our promise to our associates is rock-solid. We grow together into countless roles, positions, and opportunities and we are interested in developing the “whole” you, not just the “7 to 16” you, because life is all about balance.

Let ‘s strike a balance. At Bosch, we believe everyone is different and that is what we love. Join us and feel the difference. #LikeABosch

jobs.occupation: We are seeking general nurses for permanent positions in Norway
jobs.description:

Providing holistic care to patients, addressing their medical, hygienic and social needs.

Performing blood draws and other routine medical procedures.
Collaborating with a multidisciplinary team to deliver optimal care.
Offering emotional support and clear communication to patients and their families.
